Dialogs.Dialog: What's up, are you meeting someone？
Wait, really？ Hehe, you're putting me on the spot♪
Um, so... what should I call you？
▲紹介友達名▲. Yeah... nice to meet you.
▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
Hmm, alright, why don't you just write it here for me？
▲紹介友達名▲. Got it, got it. Nice to meet you, okay？
No way. Cut it out already, geez.
Um... you don't have to stare so intently... you know？
Um... please don't stare at me like that...
Just thinking you're a little close, maybe~
Aren't you a bit too close？
Y-You're kind of close, you know...
Um... er, is that enough now, maybe？
Er... well, I guess it's fine, yeah.
Are you his older brother, by any chance？
Um, are you his father, by any chance？
Um, could you be his older sister？
Um, could you be his mother？
Then, how are you related to him？
Um... how are you related to him？
Then could you be his little brother？
Wait, don't tell me... his mom？
Then could you be his little sister？
Um, I'm... dating him. My name is Nene Anegasaki. It's a pleasure to meet you.
You kind of look alike... Ah, never mind.
Um, thank you for always looking after him. It's a pleasure to meet you.
His older brother, I see... Hehe.
Um, it's a pleasure to meet you, big sister.
Nice to meet you. Call me Big Sis, okay？
Nice to meet you. You really look like your dad...
Hello there. Nice to meet you, okay？
I see. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Yeah... I could tell right away, hehe！
You really are family, aren't you？ Yeah...
I have a quick question... Does your family show a lot of physical affection？ No reason, just wondering.
Please continue to be nice to me, okay？
Please continue to look after us from now on.
Is my hair really that weird...？
There are so many people. It's so lively, isn't it？
Then let me ask you the same question. How about it？
Have you known him for a long time？
Did he tell you about me？
Did he say anything about me？
It's a little embarrassing, isn't it？
It feels kind of strange, doesn't it？
It's your first time doing something like this, right？
Is this sort of thing a first for you？
I see. I kind of had a feeling.
So when he can't see me... Aha, I get it？ Hehe.
Oh jeez, this is so embarrassing...
I see... Um, well, this is pretty much how we are.
So it's been a while, then？ I'm glad.
Is that so？ Oh, come on...
I'm sorry, um, please don't mind me.
I see... All right, I'll do my best too.
I see, I see. What a relief.
Oh, is that so？ Well then, I'm glad.
We haven't been together all that long yet...
We haven't been together that long yet, actually.
It's been over a year now, actually...
Um, we've been together for over a year now.
How long has it been...？ Just... a looong time.
We've already been together for quite a long time.
How he's always there for me and cherishes me... Aah, I said it! So embarrassing!
He's always by my side... and he treats me so dearly.
Um, how kind he is. Warm, I guess. Hehe, this is embarrassing.
I think it's because he's such a kind person. He's so warm.
I mean, look at him, he's handsome, right？ ...Just kidding! Hehe!
He really is good-looking. He's super popular at school, too. Hehe.
Definitely how smart he is. Since I tend to space out.
Well, you know, he's smart, and fun to talk to— um, gosh, listen to me...
No good？ Do I really have to say something like that？ Mmm... nope, still can't.
Recently... Oh, my cooking! He told me it was delicious. I worked hard on it, so that made me extra happy.
Getting praised for my cooking. I am a girl, after all. Hehe.
Recently... Definitely the present he gave me. Yeah... that made me so happy. Hehe.
Well, he gave me a present... It made me so happy.
Celebrating another special day together, I guess... Hehe, doesn't that sound kind of mature？
Getting to spend a special day with him, I'd say— Oh gosh, that's embarrassing...
Lately... Oh, I know! Having him celebrate my birthday! Hehe!
It was my birthday recently, and, well, he celebrated it with me...
What made me happy recently was— uh... nope, forget it! Just forget I said anything, okay？
What made me happy recently was when he—um... please just forget that. Ahaha...
Texting, maybe. When there aren't many messages, you can't help but worry, right？
Sometimes he doesn't text me. He can be a little lazy with that, can't he？
Worries... Hmm, maybe not enough cuddling? It makes him feel distant, you know？
He seems a bit distant, or rather, physical affection... um, actually, never mind...
Sometimes I feel our tastes in food don't really match. That's pretty important, you know？
Sometimes our tastes in food don't quite match... Oh, but I can adapt to anything, so it's fine.
He's gotten into photography lately... but he always tries to take photos from naughty angles!
He's been into photography lately... Which is fine, but, um... never mind, it's nothing.
Worries... I guess that one thing... He's a little... with kissing... I know he tries his best, but...
Um... I'd better not say. He gets his feelings hurt easily, doesn't he？ Hehe.
Like touching me out of nowhere... or being too persistent. There're times you're not in the mood, right？
Worries... Um, by any chance, is everyone really affectionate at your house？
Worries, huh... I don't really have any... lately.
Worries... um... I'm sorry, I guess I don't really have any.
My hobbies... Watching movies, and puttering around doing little chores around the house.
My hobby is watching movies. I also surprisingly enjoy doing little tidying-up tasks.
It might not really be a hobby, but I've been enjoying work lately... Plus he's there with me. Just kidding!
Lately, I've been really focused on our part-time job together.
My hobby is cooking! ...Hehe, I've been into it lately, so I wanted to say that if someone asked.
Lately, well, I've been cooking a lot. Since he's always there to eat it.
Lately, photography, maybe... Oh, not taking photos, being the subject! It makes me feel like a model.
Lately, modeling for his photos has kind of become a hobby. A hobby for both of us, really.
What I like... Hmm, I eat cough drops a lot, I guess. Yeah.
Let's see... pretty much anything. My parents raised me not to be picky, so that really helps.
Lately it's Japanese food, I think. Probably because I eat it so often.
Lately, it's Japanese food. He and I go out to eat it often.
There's a restaurant I've been going to a lot lately, so maybe their food. It's really delicious there.
There's a restaurant he and I have been going to a lot—their food. Oh, we should go together sometime!
Chinese food, maybe... Yeah. Chinese cuisine is really deep, you know？ I think I'm starting to appreciate it.
Lately it's Chinese food. He and I go out for it a lot.
Lately, before I knew it, I started liking whatever he likes... I said it out loud! How embarrassing...
His tastes seem to have rubbed off on me, so mine are the same as his now.
I'm a year older than him— a high school senior, 17.
High school senior. I ended up turning 18!
I'm a year older than him— a high school senior, 18.
What's up？ Does my hair really catch your eye that much？
Um, does my hair really catch your eye that much？
...Does my hair really look weird, after all？
Does my hair really look strange, after all？
I pretty much always have it like this, though...
I usually wear my hair like this, though...
This is... kind of his request, I guess... Heheh.
He said he prefers this style, so... Heheh.
I just got it cut recently... Does it look weird？
I talked it over with him and got it cut, but... does it not suit me？
I just dyed it recently... It doesn't look weird, does it？
I talked it over with him and tried dyeing it, but... does it look weird？
Sometimes I really can't tell... Does he have bad taste... maybe？
Um, does he have a reputation for bad taste in the family？
I see, I see... That makes sense.
I see, what a relief. I've gotta trust him, right？
Geez, are you that curious about what I'm wearing？
Um, are you that curious about my outfit？
Again...？ Does this outfit really look that weird？
Um... does this outfit really look that strange？
He asked me to wear this today... Does it look weird？
Actually, he requested this today... Does it look strange？
Actually, this was a present from him, though...
Actually, this was a present from him...
Heheh, well, that's a relief then!
I see. Yeah, that's too bad...
Hey, when you're with him, does he talk about what clothes he likes on girls？
When you're with him, does he talk about what clothes he likes on girls？
I knew it... Boys are always talking about stuff like that.
Heheh, that's cute of him. Mm-hmm.
No way. That's gotta be a lie. Heheh.
Do you wear stuff like this？
Do you ever wear stuff like this？
I knew it! We've got the exact same taste, you and me!
Ah, then we definitely share the same taste!
Maybe something a little more mature, or...？
Maybe something a little more understated, or...？
Oh, that'd look great on you... Mm-hmm.
Your blood type is A, right？
You're blood type A, aren't you？
Your blood type is B, right？
You're blood type B, aren't you？
Your blood type is AB, right？
You're blood type AB, aren't you？
Your blood type is O, right？
You're blood type O, aren't you？
Called it! I knew it, I just knew it!
Right？ I was totally sure that was it.
Huh？ But I was so sure... So what are you really？
Huh？ Really...？ So what's the real answer？
Is that so？ Hmm, I wouldn't have guessed.
Told you! So I got it right, yeah？
You have the same blood type as him, you know？
Same blood type as him, right？ Yeah, that makes sense.
Alright, my turn now. What type am I？
Okay, my turn next. What type do you think I am？
Bingo! Three cheers for easygoing, dependable Type O!
You got it! We're both Type O, so we give off the same vibe, right？ Don't we？
Too bad! The right answer is Type O. Yup, same as him. We're a pretty carefree couple.
Too bad, the answer is Type O! Yup, same as him— we're both pretty carefree, if anything.
Hmm？ ...Out of curiosity, what made you think that？
Ah, I might be like that. I see, so that's why.
Whyyy？ I'm not really like that, though...
Well, I suppose I can be like that at times.
By the way, the answer is... Ta-da! Type O! People say I'm an open book, though...
Hey, so do you believe in blood type compatibility？
Well then, do you believe in blood type compatibility？
Right？ So, which type goes best with yours？
Right？ So which type do you think is your best match？
Is that so...？ It's usually pretty accurate, though.
Is it because they're so organized and neat？
Is that... because they feel so creative, maybe？
Ohh... Is it because you like that mysterious vibe？
Of course, that's a perfect match ▼ Since you're both so laid-back.
No？ Then... oh, could it be your crush's blood type？
I see... Hmm, now I'm really curious.
Yeah. That vibe might really suit you.
I feel like I get that. Mm-hmm.
That's a match made in heaven, isn't it？
That kind of pairing really is a great match, isn't it？
Compatibility is all in your head anyway, so maybe that's just how it works for you？
Well, compatibility is all about mindset anyway, right？
So by blood type, you and he are a perfect match too.
So by blood type, you two aren't the best match, then.
How's your compatibility in real life, though？
Right？ Yeah, don't pay it any mind, don't worry.
Just checking, but... do you have an older sibling？
I thought so. You've got that younger-sibling aura. Do you have an older brother？
Right？ Then, do you have a younger brother？
Bingo！ I'm pretty good at guessing♪
An older sister, huh... Now that you mention it, do you like being pampered？
So close！ And here I really thought you had one.
By the way, I'm an only child. I always wanted brothers and sisters.
Oh, since I have the chance, let me ask...
Since I have the chance, may I ask something...？
Has he always been like this？
Has he always been like this, even as a kid？
So that's how he was, then？
I see... Huh, that's kind of surprising.
I see... I feel like that explains a whole lot.
Is he always super active at home, too？
Is he just as mischievous around the house, too？
Is he always this calm around the house, too？
Is he pretty laid-back at home, too？
Hehe, so he's the same. That's a relief.
Hehe, then he's the same as when he's with me.
Hmm... I wonder if he's just trying to act cool around me？
Is that so...？ I can't really picture that.
When he's with me, he's more on the laid-back side, I guess？
When he's with me, he's more on the bolder side, I guess？
Plus, he's always so sweet to me...
Though sometimes he can be a little cool...
Maybe that's the part of him I fell for... Hehe.
I think that's the part of him that I really love.
He told me you were a really sweet person, but...
He told me you were the cool type, but...
He told me you were on the quiet side, but...
He told me you were really lively, but...
He told me you were pretty serious, but...
He told me you were really funny, but...
Now that I meet you, you're not quite like that...
You're just like he said you were.
You really are sweet, aren't you？
You really are so sweet. Hehe.
You're actually pretty cool, aren't you？
You're actually quite cool, aren't you？ Deep down.
You're actually very composed, aren't you？
You're definitely a lively person, aren't you.
You're such a fun person to be around.
You're pretty serious, aren't you？ Yep.
It was so much fun meeting you today.
I'm so glad I got to meet you today.
Um, are you his little brother, by chance？
Um, are you his little sister, by chance？
Wait, are you his older brother, then？
Wait, are you his older sister, then？
Um... your expression was a little scary...
You're really sweet... That's what I thought.
You're pretty cool, aren't you？ Don't people tell you that？
You're so calm. Quiet, in a way.
A little too honest, maybe... Look where your eyes are.
...Felt like you were giving me a naughty look, though？
Felt like you were staring at me... Or is that just my imagination？
It's rude to stare at a girl like that, you know？
You really stare right at me, don't you. Is something on your mind？
Guess you like being touchy-feely, huh.
Maybe a little too much, though. You know, all the touching.
You should treat girls with more care. Too much touching.
You really take conversations at your own pace.
You're so on your own time. The way you time conversations is too wild.
Do you get nervous easily？ I wanted to talk a bit more.
You're the type to get nervous, huh. We didn't really get to talk much.
You're a very kind person, aren't you...
You must be a pretty cool person, aren't you.
You're such a gentle person. That's how it felt.
You seem like a really lively person.
You're a very serious person, aren't you.
Your eyes were... Well, maybe it was just my imagination.
Your stare made me a little nervous... Sorry about that.
Um, I felt like you were staring at me...
You were staring, right？ It made me kind of nervous.
Being stared at like that... It made me nervous. Yes.
Um, all the touching was... Never mind, it's nothing.
Um... does that mean you really like physical touch？
To be frank, um... I think you touched me way too much.
Your conversation timing is really at your own pace.
You really go at your own pace, don't you？ Ah, I mean with conversation timing.
Were you nervous？ I was hoping we could talk a little more.
You seemed pretty nervous. We didn't really get to talk much, did we？
You know, you look a lot like someone.
Um, you really look like someone.
That person who's popular with guys right now...
That person who's popular with girls right now...
That person who's on TV all the time...
That person I saw in town the other day...
That person everyone looks up to...
Hehe, you really are the spitting image.
Yes, I really think you're the spitting image.
Huh？ But I really thought you were the spitting image.
Is that so？ I thought you two seemed alike, though...
Really？ I thought you two seemed so alike, though...
Ah, sorry about that. I just thought you two seemed kind of alike.
Take good care of me from now on too, okay？
Please take good care of me from now on as well.
Hmm... maybe not so much, I guess.
